name: acf/booking-summary-panel
title: Booking Summary Panel
description: Shows the submitted booking's details (route, date, passengers, cost), looked up from the Gravity Forms entry matching the ?token= in the URL. Only meaningful on the Booking Confirmation page — has no CMS-editable content of its own since everything it shows is per-visitor data from their own booking.
